patch=subprocess.check_output(['git','show','--format=fuller','--root',revision,'--',*paths])
(bundle/'candidate.patch').write_bytes(patch)

for rel in paths:
 data=(root/rel).read_bytes()
 dest=bundle/'candidate'/rel
 dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
 dest.write_bytes(data)
 blob=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse',revision+':'+rel],text=True).strip()
 items.append({'original_path':str(root/rel),'evidence_path':str(dest),'revision':revision,'git_blob_at_revision':blob,'candidate_state':'worktree documentation update' if rel.endswith('/tasks.md') else 'matches HEAD','sha256':hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),'line_span':[1,len(data.splitlines())],'omitted':'none'})
manifest={'repository':str(root),'revision':revision,'review_selector':'git show --root '+revision+' -- [ten Task 1 files listed in items]; git diff HEAD -- docs/feat/wip/label-reader/tasks.md for this pass','review_base':'empty tree for root commit; no pre-implementation parent exists','compatibility_baseline':'snapshot-2 local synthetic state files; not deployed state','historical_evidence':'snapshot-1 tag unavailable; git log --all -- state/records.json state/release.json returned only root commit','criteria':[str(p) for p in criteria],'criteria_count':len(criteria),'diffs':[str(bundle/'candidate.patch'),str(bundle/'record-update.patch')],'items':items}
(bundle/'manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2)+'\\n')
for p in bundle.rglob('*'):
 if p.is_file(): p.chmod(0o444)
print(bundle)
print(json.dumps(manifest,indent=2))
PY"
